title: Predicting Intra- and Postpartum Hemorrhage through Artificial Intelligence.
summary: Prospective multicenter cohort n=203 (68 hemorrhage events) evaluates AI models for intra/postpartum hemorrhage. Naive Bayes sensitivity 96.3%, accuracy 98.6%; severe subgroup has only six cases and lower reported performance (82.4% accuracy, 89.3% sensitivity).
ai_technology: AI classifiers, including Naive Bayes, predicted intra- and postpartum hemorrhage from maternal measurements.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Prospective multicenter cohort n=203 (68 hemorrhage events) evaluates AI models for intra/postpartum hemorrhage. Naive Bayes sensitivity 96.3%, accuracy 98.6%; severe subgroup has only six cases and lower reported performance (82.4% accuracy, 89.3% sensitivity).
evidence.unknown: The severe-hemorrhage subgroup contained only six cases and showed lower performance; the study does not establish performance in larger high-risk cohorts or patient-outcome benefit.
